sections.body:
## Who we are

Rope Access Center (RAC) is the rope access training and services brand of the [Inland](https://inland.co.id) group — an architecture, construction, and building maintenance company based in South Tangerang. At Inland, work at height is everyday work: glass cleaning, façade maintenance, and repairs on multi-storey buildings. RAC brings that expertise together under one roof, both to train workers and to deliver projects.

## Training since 2024

Since 2024 RAC has run work-at-height safety training certified by Indonesia’s Ministry of Manpower: [TKPK Levels 1–3](/en/tkpk-level-1-training/) for rope access and [TKBT Levels 1–2](/en/tkbt-level-1-training/) for high structures. Our aim is simple: trainees leave with competence they can really use on site, not just a pass on the exam.

## What we believe

### Safety is not a slogan — it is a repeated decision

Safety is not settled once in a policy meeting. It is decided every morning when someone chooses to check a harness thoroughly despite being in a hurry. We train that decision, not merely the procedure around it.

### Competence must be provable

The Kemnaker certificate and K3 licence are nationally recognised proof of competence, checked by labour inspectors, contractors, and building managers. That is why every programme we run follows that official scheme.

### One standard for training and for work

Our services teams work to the standard we teach in the classroom. If we teach daily equipment checks, our project teams perform them — including on busy days and on projects running behind schedule.

## Our services

Alongside training, RAC teams deliver [glass cleaning and façade maintenance](/en/building-facade-maintenance/), [maintenance and repair at height](/en/maintenance-repair-at-height/), [visual inspection and NDT](/en/ndt-inspection-services/), [standby rescue](/en/standby-rescue-services/), and [certified technician supply](/en/rope-access-technician-supply/).

Learn more about the [TKPK and TKBT certification schemes](/en/certification/) we follow.
